name: adult blue dragon
desc: Adult Blue Dragon is a CR 16 dragon.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes three [[/item Rend]] attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShatter000]{Shatter}.

actions.name: lightning breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]-foot-wide [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=LpjgVwftzGNMgTUJ]]. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili]{Invisibility}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageHand00]{Mage Hand}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShatter000]{Shatter} 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplScrying000]{Scrying}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSending000]{Sending}

actions.name: cloaked flight
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses [[/item Spellcasting]] to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplInvisibili] on itself, and it can fly up to [[lookup @range.special activity=a3NfcMs8zHADx7zs]]. The dragon can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: sonic boom
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses Spellcasting to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShatter000]{Shatter}. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: tail swipe
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.
